name: 000-wolf-os-system
description: Wolf OS: its own system services may connect without asking: DNS (systemd-resolved), network setup (NetworkManager), time (chronyd), system, app and firmware updates (rpm-ostree, bootc, skopeo, uupd, flatpak, fwupd) and container downloads (podman, used by wolf lab and wolf install). A deny rule of your own still wins, and you can edit or delete this rule like any other.
